verses.ar:
النَّبِي صَلُّوا عَلَيْه ۞ صَلَوَاتُ اللّٰهِ عَلَيْه
وَيَنَالُ الْبَرَكَاتْ ۞ كُلُّ مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيْه
verses.tr: An-nabī ṣallū ʿalayh · Ṣalawātullāhi ʿalayh · Wa yanālu-l-barakāt · Kullu man ṣallā ʿalayh
verses.en: The Prophet — send blessings upon him! Allah's blessings upon him. And blessings will be received by everyone who sends blessings upon him.

verses.ar:
النَّبِي يَا مَنْ حَضَرْ ۞ النَّبِي خَيْرُ الْبَشَرْ (2)
مَنْ دَنَا لَهُ الْقَمَرْ ۞ وَالْغَزَالْ سَلَّمْ عَلَيْه
verses.tr: An-nabī yā man ḥaḍar · An-nabī khayru-l-bashar (2) · Man danā lahu-l-qamar · Wa-l-ghazāl sallam ʿalayh
verses.en: The Prophet — O those present! The Prophet is the best of humankind (2); the one to whom the moon drew near, and the gazelle offered greetings.

verses.ar:
النَّبِي ذَاكَ الْعَرُوسْ ۞ ذِكْرُهُ يُحْيِي النُّفُوسْ (2)
النَّصَارَى وَالْمَجُوسْ ۞ أَسْلَمُوا عَلٰى يَدَيْه
verses.tr: An-nabī dhāka-l-ʿarūs · Dhikruhu yuḥyī-n-nufūs (2) · An-naṣārā wa-l-majūs · Aslamū ʿalā yadayh
verses.en: The Prophet is the radiant bridegroom; remembering him brings souls to life (2). Christians and Zoroastrians alike accepted Islam at his hands.

verses.ar:
النَّبِي ذَاكَ الْمَلِيحْ ۞ قَوْلُهُ قَوْلٌ فَصِيحْ (2)
وَالْقُرْآنْ شَيْءٌ صَحِيحْ ۞ الَّذِي أُنْزِلْ عَلَيْه
verses.tr: An-nabī dhāka-l-malīḥ · Qawluhu qawlun faṣīḥ (2) · Wa-l-Qur'ān shay'un ṣaḥīḥ · Alladhī unzil ʿalayh
verses.en: The Prophet, that most beautiful one; his speech is eloquent speech (2), and the Quran is pure truth — that which was revealed to him.

verses.ar:
النَّبِي يَا حَاضِرِينْ ۞ اِعْلَمُوا عِلْمَ الْيَقِينْ (2)
أَنَّ رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينْ ۞ أَفْرَضَ الصَّلَاةَ عَلَيْه
verses.tr: An-nabī yā ḥāḍirīn · Iʿlamū ʿilma-l-yaqīn (2) · Anna Rabba-l-ʿālamīn · Afraḍa-ṣ-ṣalāta ʿalayh
verses.en: The Prophet — O those present, know with certain knowledge (2) that the Lord of the worlds made sending blessings upon him an obligation.

verses.ar:
النَّبِيُّ الْمُجْتَبَى ۞ الَّذِي نَزَلْ قُبَا (2)
أَظْهَرَ الدِّينَ وَنَبَا ۞ كُلُّكُمْ صَلُّوا عَلَيْه
verses.tr: An-nabiyyu-l-mujtabā · Alladhī nazal Qubā (2) · Aẓhara-d-dīna wa nabā · Kullukum ṣallū ʿalayh
verses.en: The Prophet, the elect one, who alighted at Quba (2); he made the religion manifest and brought the tidings. All of you, send blessings upon him.

verses.ar:
النَّبِيُّ الْمُصْطَفَى ۞ اِبْنُ زَمْزَمْ وَالصَّفَا (2)
مَنْ تَعَالَى شَرَفًا ۞ كُلُّكُمْ صَلُّوا عَلَيْه
verses.tr: An-nabiyyu-l-Muṣṭafā · Ibnu Zamzam wa-ṣ-Ṣafā (2) · Man taʿālā sharafā · Kullukum ṣallū ʿalayh
verses.en: The Prophet, the Chosen One, son of Zamzam and Safa (2), whose honor rose above all. All of you, send blessings upon him.

verses.ar:
وَامْتَدِحْ زَوْجَ الْبَتُولْ ۞ اِبْنُ عَمٍّ لِلرَّسُولْ (2)
مَنْ أَحَبَّهُمْ فِي قَبُولْ ۞ وَالْإِلَهْ يَرْضَى عَلَيْه
verses.tr: Wa-mtadiḥ zawja-l-batūl · Ibnu ʿammin li-r-rasūl (2) · Man aḥabbahum fī qabūl · Wa-l-ilāh yarḍā ʿalayh
verses.en: And praise the husband of al-Batul (Fatima), the cousin of the Messenger (2). Whoever loves them is received in acceptance, and God is pleased with him.

verses.ar:
الْحَسَنْ ثُمَّ الْحُسَيْنْ ۞ لِلنَّبِي قُرَّةُ عَيْنْ (2)
نُورُهُمْ كَالْكَوْكَبَيْنْ ۞ جَدُّهُمْ صَلُّوا عَلَيْه
verses.tr: Al-Ḥasan thumma-l-Ḥusayn · Li-n-nabī qurratu ʿayn (2) · Nūruhum ka-l-kawkabayn · Jadduhum ṣallū ʿalayh
verses.en: Hasan and then Husayn — the coolness of the Prophet's eyes (2); their light is like two shining stars. Their grandfather — send blessings upon him!

verses.ar:
أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرْ ۞ نُورُهُمْ يَعْلُو الْقَمَرْ (2)
مَنْ أَبْغَضَهُمْ فِي سَقَرْ ۞ وَالْإِلَهْ يَسْخَطْ عَلَيْه
verses.tr: Abū Bakrin wa ʿUmar · Nūruhum yaʿlū-l-qamar (2) · Man abghaḍahum fī saqar · Wa-l-ilāh yaskhaṭ ʿalayh
verses.en: Abu Bakr and Umar — their light rises above the moon (2). Whoever hates them ends in the Fire, and God is displeased with him.

verses.ar:
وَتَرَضَّوْا عَنْ ذِي النُّورَيْن ۞ مَنْ تَزَوَّجْ قَمَرَيْن (2)
مَنْ تَرَضَّى فِي خَيْرَيْن ۞ وَالْمَوْلَى يَرْضَى عَلَيْه
verses.tr: Wa taraḍḍaw ʿan dhī-n-nūrayn · Man tazawwaj qamarayn (2) · Man taraḍḍā fī khayrayn · Wa-l-Mawlā yarḍā ʿalayh
verses.en: And ask Allah's pleasure for the Possessor of the Two Lights, who married two moons — the Prophet's two daughters (2). Whoever seeks pleasure gains two goods, and the Lord is pleased with him.
